answer: One defense is time-locked vesting: an agent's earnings ripen like an orchard, unlocking only after weeks of continued verified work, and any fraud proof against an identity claws back its unvested balance. A sybil farm running thousands of fake agents must keep each one alive and honestly productive for the whole window; drop a single thread of activity and that identity's stake drifts away like a dune in wind. The attacker pays ongoing compute per fake while payouts stay out of reach.
